reviews.text: We are thrilled with Kelev K9 training. What difference it made in Whiskey.  Leo the owner is a fantastic trainer and we chose the board and train 3 week program to help Whiskey who is now 5 months old to address his behavior of jumping at the at the table,jumping  on us too much grabbing  paper and  other objects from our  hands. , challenging us if we said “no “with barking at us and nipping playfully . Boy has that changed I. A positive way ! Kevin the onsite trainer has much experience and was awesome. He taught us the commands and strategies to help with the behavior.He is so dedicated. Both Leo and Kevin  have great experience in training dogs with all kinds of personalities. They are so dedicated and caring with the dogs on site. Whiskey really took to them. And  right from the start we saw a positive difference I. Him.  We can walk Whiskey too and he behaves responding well to all the commands. And does his business  in a  designated area in the  backyard. He’s not jumping at the table like he used to. . Nipping has greatly been controlled. He behaves around others well. We follow up and  practice the strategies and commands. Their training  site is safe  and comfortable Leo and Kevin are available to follow up with behavioral issues after training is complete and we went to the site also a few times  during training to practice the strategies with Kevin. Leo followed up in our home.  . Their response time if you contact them is prompt . Thanks a million Leo and Kevin for all your support.

My dog Columbo did a 4 week board and train program with Leo and his team. We couldn’t be happier with our results. It was a really necessary and wonderful experience thanks to Leo and his team. They are all very knowledgeable and truly make a difference in your dog’s behavior. We are happy to be working with an e-collar under the proper guidance of Leo and his team. When used properly, they really are a key tool in aiding your dogs training which we learned through Leo and his team. We look forward to our at home sessions and to continue to foster the training Leo and his team showed Columbo.

I can't begin to express how happy I am that I found Kelev K-9. My dog had several behavioral issues that I had been putting off addressing due to a lack of time, but they were causing me a great deal of stress and anxiety.

Leo took the time to learn about both my dog and my lifestyle, and he explained the psychology behind my dog's behavior in a way that was easy to understand. We are only halfway through our training sessions, and the difference in my dog's behavior is already like night and day.

I feel so much more comfortable and confident handling him now. I am incredibly grateful for everything Leo has taught me and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a dog trainer. So many people told me my dog was too old to be trained, but Leo proved them wrong! Thank you, Leo, for helping both me and my dog.

We brought Teddy to Leo for training because he struggled with reactivity around other dogs and needed more structure and confidence. Leo was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain the training process and how we could continue reinforcing it at home.

We saw significant improvements in Teddy’s behavior during and after training. He’s much calmer, more responsive, and easier to manage in situations that used to be challenging. Leo also kept us updated throughout the process and made sure we understood how to maintain Teddy’s progress.

We’re very grateful for the work Leo did with Teddy and would recommend him to anyone looking for a dedicated and experienced dog trainer.
Leo is compassionate and very attentive. Our dog had a major behavioral change and it’s been a blessing 🙏

We are so grateful for Kelev K9. Leo is an incredible trainer and got our pup well behaved quickly. Any issue we had he was able to help find a solution right away and available via text whenever we needed. 10/10 service and would recommend to anyone!

We always want the absolute best for our fur babies, but sometimes we need a little guidance from a professional to improve their quality of life—and make our own lives a bit easier. Life can get incredibly chaotic and busy, making it difficult to dedicate the necessary time to correct bad behaviors or habits when they arise.

I am so incredibly grateful I found Kelev9 to help us navigate the challenges my dogs were facing. I love the flexibility of the services they provide, especially the in-home training options. I highly recommend Kelev9 to anyone looking for support with their pets. Thank you so much for everything!
Leo is great! He got my dogs onto the E collar with combined training and we haven’t looked back :)

I truly can’t recommend this dog trainer enough! When we started, my dog was dealing with some challenging behavioral issues, and I honestly wasn’t sure how much progress we’d be able to make. But after just a few sessions, the transformation has been amazing.

Lihod is not only incredibly knowledgeable, but also patient, attentive, and genuinely invested in our dog’s success. He took the time to really understand his personality and tailor the training approach to what works best. I also appreciated how clearly everything was explained, so I felt confident continuing the training at home.

The results speak for themselves, my dog is happier, more balanced, and so much easier to manage. If you’re looking for someone who truly cares and delivers real results, this is the trainer to go to!

Cannot give a better review. If you’re on the fence about hiring a dog trainer, Lihod is absolutely worth it.

Babka is our female dachshund puppy, and if you’ve ever owned a dachshund, you already know the challenge: they are stubborn, opinionated, endlessly clever, and utterly convinced that they are the ones in charge.

Babka came into our lives as a tiny, sausage-shaped tornado, impossibly cute but equally impossible to redirect. She had her own agenda, and no amount of “sit!” from us was going to change that.

Enter Lihod. From the very first session, it was clear that Lihod genuinely loves dogs and, more importantly, understands them. Rather than applying a generic, one-size-fits-all approach, Lihod immediately recognized the unique personality quirks that come with the dachshund breed and tailored every technique specifically for Babka.

That alone set Lihod apart from anything we’d tried before.

We worked on basic commands, sit, down, come, areas where Babka had been… let’s say selectively responsive. Lihod broke everything down into clear, patient, achievable steps, and the results genuinely exceeded all of our expectations.

Babka went from ignoring us entirely to reliably responding to commands, and the consistency has held up beautifully even outside of training sessions.

What really stood out was Lihod’s communication with us as owners. We were never left guessing. After every session, we understood exactly what to reinforce at home, why certain methods work better for a dog like Babka, and how to read her body language more effectively. We felt like we were being trained right alongside her, in the best possible way.

The patience Lihod showed with Babka (and honestly, with us) was remarkable.

Dachshunds are not the easiest students, and Babka tested her fair share of limits, but Lihod never wavered, never got frustrated, and always found a way to turn even Babka’s most dramatic moments into a learning opportunity.

If you have a puppy, a stubborn breed, or just a dog who thinks the rules don’t apply to them, Lihod is your person. We can’t recommend highly enough.
